text:
maria: kicking off hetero-quant bring-up for stella-7b-v2. goal: evaluate mixed FP8/INT8/AWQ across layers, then validate hosted -> private handshake. starting smoke on hosted canary.
sam: nice. what's the initial traffic plan?
maria: 2% hosted canary (FP8 baseline), 2% hosted hetero-INT8 (layerwise), then cross-compare to AWQ candidate. sequence: smoke -> extended eval -> gradual corridor. abort criteria spelled out below.
raj: please also run KV-cache compatibility checks. last time mixed-Q caused cache key shape mismatch on longctx tests.
zane: adding to checklist: golden prompt set, adversarial prompts, and a sample of high-temp completions to catch sampling drift.
lina: will add targeted regression evals (QA, summarization, codegen). how are we measuring accuracy delta? top-level metric?
maria: primary: pass@1-like QA F1 on golden set, secondary: rouge/sacrebleu for summarization, code exec bucket for codegen. define delta threshold: -1.0% absolute on primary = fail for canary.
sam: latency SLO: we accept up to +15% p95 increase vs FP8 baseline. cost savings goal: at least 20% compute/rcu improvement for hetero-INT8 vs FP8 to justify.
raj: what about private deployment parity? we need handshake rules so if private infra runs different kernels (A100 vs H100) we can fallback.
maria: handshake rules: prior to traffic handoff run a private smoke with identical model bits and microbatch config. If private p95 > hosted p95 by >20% or accuracy delta >0.8% -> hold and route to hosted fp32 variant.
zane: suggest automated gating in rollout config. something like:

```
rollout_policy:
  steps:
    - name: hosted-smoke
      traffic: 0.02
      checks:
        - eval: golden-qa
          max_delta: -1.0
        - perf: p95
          max_increase_pct: 15
    - name: hosted-extended
      traffic: 0.10
      checks: [...]
    - name: private-handshake
      traffic: 0.02
      env: private
      checks:
        - perf_compare: hosted
          max_diff_pct: 20
        - kvcache_check: true
    - name: promoted
      traffic: 0.30
      fallback: fp32-hosted
```

sam: looks good. where will eval-bot push results? dashboard or thread?
eval-bot: pushing per-step artifacts to /evals/hetero-stella-v2/ and posting summary here.
maria: also note: mixed quant changes may affect logits temperature scaling. include sampling calibration (topk/softmax) check.
lina: added a small test to run 1k stochastic samples and compare distribution stats (entropy, top1 variance).
raj: any manual QA signoff points?
maria: yes — after hosted-extended and private-handshake a dev-ml owner must approve; otherwise policy auto-rollbacks.
zane: edge-case: AWQ variant sometimes degrades codegen on long context due to attention kernel truncation. include longctx-run for 8k tokens.
sam: can we auto-detect regressions by running pairwise diffs against golden outputs and flag >5% change in tokens-level edit distance?
raj: good idea. add token edit-distance monitor.

deploy-bot: created canary stella-hetero-int8-hosted #canary-1714023456
maria: starting smoke run now.
eval-bot: smoke results: primary_delta: -0.62% (below -1.0? no), p95_latency_increase: 8.6ms (+9%), kvcache: PASS, longctx-truncation: fail @ 8k in AWQ variant (stack trace saved)
sam: AWQ failing longctx is expected in older AWQ build. is this the AWQ candidate or our hetero-INT8?
maria: AWQ candidate — hetero-INT8 passed longctx. AWQ flagged, we'll block AWQ from private-handshake until fix.
zane: mark AWQ as blocked for private. proceed with hetero-INT8 hosted extended.

maria: rolling to hosted-extended (10%).
eval-bot: extended run summary: primary_delta: -0.95%, p95 +11%, cost_estimate: -24% compute, token_quality_regressions: 0.8% flagged small paraphrases, token-edit-distance >5% on 2 small cases (non-critical)
sam: primary delta still under -1.0 threshold, perf within +15%. approve to start private-handshake?
raj: approve but ensure private infra uses identical microbatch and kernel flags. I will kick private smoke.

deploy-bot: initiating private-handshake job on customer-vpc-3
maria: watch for mismatch in compiled kernels: ensure compilation flags: --enable-fp8-kernels, --quant-layer-map file attached.

eval-bot: private-handshake results: p95_private vs hosted_p95 = +12% (within 20%), primary_delta_private = -1.15% (exceeds -1.0 threshold), kvcache: PASS
sam: primary_delta_private -1.15% > -1.0 -> policy should abort promotion and fallback.
maria: agreed. we should automatically route private traffic to hosted-fp32 fallback and open a regression ticket. I'll capture diffs and logs.
zane: possible cause: different kernel inter-op leading to slight rounding. file compiled kernel versions and quant maps.

maria: opening ticket ML-4821 with diffs, linking eval artifacts. we can try microbatch tuning and re-quantize the troublesome layers.
raj: also add a short-circuit: if private delta in ( -1.5%, -1.0% ] create hotfix attempt; if < -1.5% immediate block and rollback.

maria: for now, policy action taken: private promotion aborted, private traffic routed to hosted-fp32 fallback, hosted hetero-INT8 stayed at 10%.

lina: adding follow-up plan: re-run private quantize with deterministic seed + layerwise smoothing and re-eval only the top-5 offending prompts.
sam: thanks. good catch on the AWQ longctx failure too.

maria: summary: hetero-INT8 looks promising on hosted; AWQ blocked for private due longctx bug; private handshake failed accuracy gate by 0.15pp, we will re-quant and retry with tighter kernel parity.

zane: can someone add a short note in runbook: "private-handshake accuracy gate uses absolute primary delta -1.0%" and include the microbatch/kernel checklist.
maria: will update runbook and ping infra for kernel parity automation.

deploy-bot: canary 1714023456 paused for private-handshake abort. artifacts: /evals/hetero-stella-v2/1714023456
maria: thanks all. follow-ups: ML-4821 (diffs), OPS-2337 (kernel parity), and a small RFC for adjustable gates per-customer. tagging owners.

sam: :thumbsup:
lina: 👍
raj: on it.
